company_profile.company_stage: large public electric power and energy infrastructure company

sources.title: NextEra Energy company overview
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy publicly describes electric utility, renewable generation, energy infrastructure, reliability, and long-term investment in cleaner energy systems.

sources.title: NextEra Energy careers
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy careers material emphasizes safety, customer service, operational excellence, innovation, teamwork, and energy-sector impact.

sources.title: NextEra Energy about us: leaders and core values
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy states that its leaders embody core values of excellence, integrity, and respect, and frames its century-long history around innovation, customer value, and reliable energy solutions.

sources.title: Life at NextEra Energy: culture
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's culture page says success begins with people, describes attracting people with unique perspectives and experiences, commits to respect and an engaged team, and cites 14 employee resource groups as culture advisers.

sources.title: Life at NextEra Energy: innovation programs
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy describes continuous improvement as central to its identity and lists an annual Hack Week, an in-house startup innovation hub, an innovation summit, and AI-equipped drones used in power restoration.

sources.title: Getting hired at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's getting-hired page directs candidates to Edison Electric Institute sample employment tests and groups featured jobs by accounting and finance, engineering, IT, linework, nuclear, power delivery, and power generation.

sources.title: Sample employment test and retest policy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy says it uses consistently administered pre-employment tests designed by the Edison Electric Institute for several craft, clerical, and plant roles, and publishes a retest waiting period after unsuccessful attempts.

sources.title: Corporate jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's corporate jobs page seeks bar-raising candidates committed to changing the world, emphasizes continuous learning and development, and describes finance, technology, engineering, customer service, and internship teams.

sources.title: Field jobs at NextEra Energy
sources.public_safe_signal: NextEra Energy's field jobs page describes lineworkers, cable splicers, power delivery, power generation, and nuclear careers, and ties field work to reliable electricity for more than 12 million Florida customers.

culture_principles.name: Excellence, integrity, and respect
culture_principles.description: NextEra Energy names excellence, integrity, and respect as core values and says its leaders are expected to embody them while building an environment where innovation and people are valued.

culture_principles.name: Big goals with continuous improvement
culture_principles.description: Company career material says its culture centers on setting big goals and continuous improvement, reinforced by Hack Week, an innovation summit, and an in-house startup hub.

culture_principles.name: Different perspectives as an operating input
culture_principles.description: NextEra Energy says embracing differences fuels innovation and better decisions, and points to 14 employee resource groups that advise on evolving the culture.

culture_principles.name: Reliability and customer value at scale
culture_principles.description: Public pages connect utility and field work to reliable, affordable electricity for millions of customers, framing operational and engineering choices as customer-serving work.

hiring_signals.signal: Prepares for structured aptitude and job-knowledge testing rather than assuming interviews are only conversational.
Shows safety-first and reliability-minded judgment when describing operational decisions under time pressure.
Demonstrates continuous learning and a pattern of raising performance rather than settling on current methods.
For technical and field roles, explains practical electrical, mechanical, or plant fundamentals through hands-on examples.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming the process is an unstructured conversation with no assessment or job-knowledge component.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra Energy publishes that several roles use consistently administered pre-employment tests, so preparation that ignores assessment steps may misrepresent readiness; this is a preparation signal, not an official disqualifier.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Clean-energy enthusiasm that never connects to reliability, affordability, regulation, or customer impact.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Company material consistently frames energy work through reliability and customer value alongside innovation, so mission-only answers miss the operating context the sources describe.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating innovation as novelty without evidence of disciplined execution or continuous improvement.
anti_signals.risk_reason: NextEra Energy pairs innovation language with continuous improvement, structured programs, and operational outcomes rather than novelty for its own sake.
